name: continuum-site-gate
description: Continuum Prompt 40 site gate. No build step; this is a static site (Framework preset: Other, per README.txt). This package.json exists only so Vercel places deploy/middleware.js at the same level as package.json, as required by Vercel Routing Middleware, and so @vercel/functions can be installed as a dependency for the gate's rewrite()/next() helpers.
